item.title: Kawaguchiko & the Fuji Five Lakes: Mount Fuji Across the Water — Guide
item.description: The Fuji Five Lakes (Fujigoko) are a string of five lakes at the northern foot of Mount Fuji, formed by ancient lava flows, offering some of the mountain’s most celebrated reflections across the water and panoramic viewpoints in every season. Kawaguchiko is the most accessible and developed of the five, ringed with lakeside resorts, ropeways, museums and hot springs, and famous for the ‘upside-down Fuji’ reflection on calm days, autumn foliage framing the peak, and clear winter panoramas when the snow-capped mountain is at its sharpest.
